app.description: Stamp a vector index with its embedding model's fingerprint, check it before querying, and re-embed safely.
app.epilog: Exit codes for check: 0 same, 10 drift, 11 different, 12 no fingerprint. migrate: 13 switch refused. Other failures: 1 error, 2 usage, 4 save failed.
cmd.demo: Run the offline practice demo (mock embedders, no network).
cmd.stamp: Record the fingerprint of an embedder in a store.
cmd.check: Compare an embedder with the stored fingerprint.
cmd.migrate: Re-embed an index into a green collection, report quality, optionally switch.
opt.lang: Output language: en or ko (default: EMBEDSTAMP_LANG, then LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES, LANG).
opt.store: Store spec: local://<dir>, sidecar://<file> or chroma://<db_dir>/<collection>.
opt.model: Model name to record (default: taken from the embedder spec).
opt.doc_prefix: Prefix added to documents (and probe sentences).
opt.compact: Store only a 32-dimensional summary (small, less precise).
opt.to: Embedder spec of the new model.
opt.from: Embedder spec of the old model (enables the top-k overlap measurement).
opt.queries: Text file with one query per line for the overlap measurement.
opt.k: Top-k used for self-recall and overlap (default 10).
opt.switch: Switch names after migrating (otherwise the old index stays live).
opt.min_self_recall: Refuse to switch below this self-recall (default 0.9).
check.hint.drift: Close to the stored model but not identical; queries still work, results may shift.
check.hint.different: The embedder does not match the index. Use the original model or run `embedstamp migrate`.
check.nofp: No fingerprint found in {store}. Run `embedstamp stamp` while the index still matches its model.
reason.probe_cosine_low: probe sentences point in unrelated directions
show.title: Fingerprint in {store}
migrate.overlap: overlap@{k} between old and new results={value}
migrate.switched: switched: {store} now serves {model}; old data kept as {blue}
migrate.not_switched: Not switched; {green} is ready. Re-run with --switch to make it live.
mock.banner: [practice mock] Fake embedders, no model and no network. The numbers are not those of real models.
demo.step1: 1/5 Build a {n}-document index with model {model} ({dim} dims) and stamp it.
demo.step2: 2/5 Swap the embedder to {model} ({dim} dims, like before) and run {n} fixed queries.
demo.noerror: No error was raised. Results simply changed.
demo.overlap: overlap@{k} with the original results: {value} (the original model against itself: {baseline})
demo.step3: 3/5 Check the index fingerprint with the new embedder.
demo.guard: A Guard would raise EmbeddingMismatchError before the first query.
demo.step4: 4/5 Re-embed every document with {model} into a green collection (migrate).
demo.step5: 5/5 Switch names so the green collection goes live.
demo.done: Done. The same flow works on Chroma with ChromaStore; see the README.
help.help: show this help message and exit
err.not_migratable: this store cannot be migrated; use local://<dir> or chroma://<db_dir>/<collection>
err.empty_source: {store} has no documents, so there is nothing to re-embed. migrate copies the documents of an existing index; `embedstamp stamp` only writes the fingerprint and the CLI cannot add documents. Add them with your vector store or LocalIndex.add(...) first (see examples/migrate_local.py), or point --store at a filled index such as chroma://<db_dir>/<collection>.
migrate.reused: Every document was already in {green} from an earlier run; nothing was re-embedded.
